Dialogs.Dialog: I heard a rumor there's a really delicious donut shop.
Ah！ Could that be the one that sells from a wagon？
I've heard the rumors too. It pops up and disappears without warning, but it's supposed to be really delicious.
Here one minute, gone the next, huh... Now I want to go look for it.
Then if you find it, you have to tell me too, okay？
Of course！ Let's eat them together.
(Ah, is that the donut shop from the rumors？)
(All right, I'll buy some for ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
Wow！ Could these be the rumored donuts？
Yeah, looks like it. Let's dig in.
Thank you♪ Then I won't hold back. Let's eat.
Huh... these are so good！ I've never had donuts like this.
A donut wagon... how cute♪ Maybe someday I'll open a shop too？ Hehe.
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s shop, huh. I bet it'd be a big hit too.
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, do you like crepes？
I guess... why？ Are you going to make me some？
No. The other day, Mama bought me a crepe while she was out...
It was so delicious I wanted you to try it too... but it's a mobile shop, so it wasn't in the same place anymore.
Huh... so the only way to eat one is to run into it by chance？
Seems like it... Mama hasn't seen it since either.
I see. Then shall I go look for it？
Really？ I'd be so happy if you found it♪
(Ah, is that the crepe shop from the rumors？)
The crepe shop！ Wow, you really found it♪
Really, it smells so good. Hey, let's eat？
I said I wanted you to try them... but honestly, I wanted to eat them again myself.
Yeah, I wish we could do something about it.
Wouldn't you feel refreshed after a sweet, cold gelato？
You know, a friend from my class was saying she found a delicious gelato shop♪
But it's a mobile shop, so apparently you can't always buy from it.
Maybe it's a seasonal shop... all right, I'll go look for it.
(Ah, is that the gelato shop from the rumors？)
How about that, I found it？
Hehe, amazing, amazing. Thanks for your hard work in this heat♪
I really wanted to eat it with ▲高嶺＊＊▲, so I searched for it.
Thank you. Then shall we dig in？
Mmm, cold and delicious！ It's so refreshing.
Really, it was worth the effort.
The smell of roasted chestnuts♪ Just kidding.
Haha, what's that supposed to mean？
Around this time of year, a mobile roasted chestnut stand pops up somewhere in town. I look forward to eating them every year.
Huh, then I want to try them too.
(Ah, is that the chestnut stand from the rumors？)
(All right, I'll buy some for ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
Huh？ ...Ah, I do！ The smell of autumn.
Roasted chestnuts！ You remembered what I told you the other day？
So ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s autumn treat is achieved for this year too.
Hehe, I have plenty of other things I look forward to, you know？
Haha, I'll have my work cut out for me.
It's winter, of course it is. Hehe！
You seem to be having fun, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
You just have to think of the fun things you can only do in winter.
Like buying a piping-hot baked sweet potato from a potato truck and eating it.
Oh right, you love sweet potatoes.
I do♪ Especially, sometimes this really delicious potato truck shows up... but it's hard to find.
(Ah, is that the potato truck from the rumors？)
(All right, I'll buy one for ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
What's up？ You look like you're having fun.
I found a winter-only fun thing. Look.
Ah, a baked sweet potato♪ Could it be from that truck？
Yeah. I remembered what ▲高嶺＊＊▲ said and looked for it.
It's still piping hot. Can I eat it？
Hehe, so warm and sweet and delicious▼
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ looks so happy eating baked sweet potato...)
Lately everyone around me's been buzzing about the same thing.
Ah, you mean the story about someone seeing a UFO？
That！ You heard about it too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes, it's all anyone around me talks about too.
I see. All of Towano must be buzzing about UFOs right now.
Hey, several people saw it at the same time, right？ I wonder why nobody took a picture.
If you ever see a UFO, you have to take a picture, okay？
Got it, leave it to me！
Ah！ Is this... could it be a UFO？
Amazing... they really exist... I wish I could've seen it too.
If you showed this to everyone, it would cause a huge stir.
Hey, do you know about Towassie？
Yes, a mysterious creature that supposedly lives in Lake Towano.
Huh, there's a rumor like that？
It seems to be a famous story around here from way back.
Something like that being right here in town is kind of fun.
Right. Whether it exists or not... getting excited about it like this is fun.
(If I find it, maybe I can get a picture...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, let me show you something cool.
This. Can you tell what's in the photo？
Um... ah！ Could it be Towassie!?
It's a genuine, authentic photo I took myself.
I was surprised too. Never thought I'd be the one to find it.
Lucky, I wanted to see it too...
It's pre-test nerves. The good kind！
Hehe, what's that？ Anyway, what's your goal？ I want to hear it.
Hey, midterms are coming up soon. Are you ready？
Hey, finals are coming up soon. Are you ready？
Doesn't look like it's going that well... are you okay？
I see. Then what's your goal？
Hey, are you studying properly for midterms？
Hey, are you studying properly for finals？
Geez, if you look so gloomy, you won't get good results, you know？
Don't scare me... I'll be ready in time.
Really？ Then maybe you can tell me what rank you're aiming for.
Really？ Are you sure about setting such a high goal？
Well, a higher goal gets me more fired up.
Aiming big... yes, but I think it's good.
Where there's a will, there's a way.
Yes, I think that's good. I'll cheer you on.
So that means... you're already studying properly？
Sort of. I'll work even harder from here on.
Oh, so you were pretty confident？ No need for Takane-sensei... then？
Hmm, I might want some help from Sensei.
I see. Yes, you'll be fine.
I'll go at my own pace.
Really？ I'm sure you'll be fine.
Thanks. Hearing that gets me motivated.
I see, you could aim even... no, setting a goal is what matters. Go for it！
All right, I'll make good on my word.
Then let's both work hard to reach our goals.
If there's anything I can help with, just say so... anytime.
Let's both get fired up and get through it！
Good work. How do you think it went？
Good work. Hey, how did the test go？
Good work. How did you do today？
Then let's do our best on tomorrow's test too.
There's another test tomorrow, so let's both give it our best.
Okay, let's do our best tomorrow too. Go for it！
It's finally all over. Good work this week.
The tests are finally over. Good work.
And that's the end of test period！ Good work♪
The test rankings are finally out. I wonder how I did...
No, it's not a dream！ Amazing... I'm even more impressed with you.
I'm impressed. You worked really hard.
I'm... first!? I can't believe it...
What's wrong？ Your mouth is hanging open.
Look, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ I'm in first place！
Ah, you reached your goal？ Congratulations.
Ah, a fist pump. So you reached your goal？
Wow, congratulations. You really are amazing.
Ah... you reached your goal. Congratulations！
I really worked hard this time, if I do say so myself.
Good work. I'm glad you got a result you're happy with♪
Ah... you reached your goal？ Congratulations.
Let's keep this up and do our best next time too.
I'm glad you reached your goal.
You look so relieved. That's great.
Congratulations. Next time, let's aim higher.
Was aiming for first place too reckless？
I think it's good to challenge yourself. Let's try again next time！
Too bad... first place was out of reach, huh.
Let's do our best next time？ I'll help too.
Don't be so disappointed？ I think aiming for first place means something.
Yes. Let's get revenge next time！
You didn't reach your goal, but you worked hard, so I think that's okay.
You looked cool working hard toward your goal.
Um... I don't know what to say...
Haha, you don't need to worry about me that much...
Okay... cheer up. Let's do our best next time.
This result is a step toward next time！ Let's work hard together again.
Ugh... I didn't make the top 100...
It's okay！ Next time you'll make the top 100 for sure.
Ugh... I didn't make the top 100.
It can't be helped, I didn't put in enough effort.
Next time, let's both work hard so you reach your goal.
That's a shame, you were so close.
It can't be helped. I'll do my best next time.
Anyway, good work. It was tough, but you worked hard.
Yeah, good work to you too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Now that you're free from tests, what do you want to do most？
A date, of course！ Let's have lots of fun.
Exams are over... and before we know it, it's almost summer vacation？
Yeah. Let's enjoy every bit of it！
Exams are over and it's almost winter break already... time flies, huh？
Yeah. Let's enjoy the year-end and New Year events together.
You know, I heard something from a friend...
A story called "The Ghost of Towano Castle."
Huh, a ghost. A spooky story.
Seems like it. Lately, people say they've been hearing something like moaning at Towano Castle at night.
Well, that's a common kind of story... were you into that sort of thing？
My friend was so serious about it that it got me a little curious.
Then let's go now. It might still be early, though.
I wonder if this is the right area...
It's pretty big... want to walk around a bit？
Um, didn't you just hear something？
By the way, I wonder what happened with that story from before.
You know, "The Ghost of Towano Castle."
It's still bugging me a little... would you come with me again？
Last time we were around here, right？
Ah... hey, have you heard about it？
You know, "The Legend of the Dracula Mansion."
There's a Western-style mansion in this town, right？ It's a story about that...
It seems some kind of ritual is held there every night.
That's what nobody knows. Just that you can hear strange sounds.
Seeing it like this, it is a little scary...
No, at this hour... I think it's okay.
Can't tell what's going on inside...
Right... but we can't just walk in.
But if we hang around outside, we'll look like weirdos...
Yeah, I heard it... what is that sound？
I wonder what happened with that rumor...
It was scary, but I'm still curious...
Will you come with me again？
...I wonder if we'll hear it again.
...I don't hear it. Was it my imagination？
I felt like I heard it clearly last time...
(I could tell her the truth... but I'll keep quiet, just for fun.)
By the way, I saw something on the news...
I didn't see it... Bigfoot's an unidentified creature, right？
Right. Apparently its footprints were found in the mountains.
Huh... footprints alone don't prove it's real, though.
...Come to think of it, that's true.
Haha, isn't it just someone's prank？
Maybe... but they said there's a reward if you find it.
It's like a fantasy world, it's a little exciting.
It'd be fun if it were real...
Things don't work out like a fantasy, huh.
It turned out to be someone's prank after all.
It'd be scary if it were real, but I wish it had stayed a mystery...
I'm surprised ▲高嶺＊＊▲ was so into it.
Well, it's not often something mysterious happens so close to home. I got my hopes up.
I see. And in the end it was a prank...
(I'd better keep quiet about what I saw...)
Ah... have you heard this story？
You know, it's called "The Ghost of the Valley."
A ghost, huh... never heard of it. Is it a local story？
Yes, it seems to appear in the valley in Oku-Towano...
Supposedly the ghost of a woman who died with lingering regrets...
I wonder if it's a sad story...
Yeah, there are stories like that. Legends of tragic love.
Remember we talked about "The Ghost of the Valley" before？
No, nothing. Maybe it was just a rumor.
Well, actually, I got this email...
Is this... an email from the ghost？
It's probably a prank, but it's something, huh？
...Hey, were you trying to scare me...
Huh... no. It's an email from someone else, see？
(She's lost in thought. Well, she seems to be enjoying it...)
Hey, remember we went to the amusement park the other day？
Actually, I think I dropped something there.
A lace handkerchief. It was my favorite...
I see... did you report it to the park？
You probably should. Someone might have turned it in.
Do you know "The Mascot Ghost of the Amusement Park"？
Yes. It seems to pick up lost items at the park after closing.
And if the ghost picks up your lost item, you have to get it back in person... or you'll be cursed.
Ah... so that's why you haven't reported it.
I wonder if they'll let us in.
All right. Let's look before it gets too late.
Finding it in a place this big... and it's getting late too.
What are you kids doing here？ The park closed a long time ago.
Ah, a lace handkerchief. Yep, got it right here.
No problem, no problem. Well... changing is a pain, so I've been doing my rounds dressed like this... so that's the rumor, huh.
I'll probably get in trouble eventually, so I'll change properly from now on. Now, you two head home too.
Right... I'm glad I didn't get cursed...
Haha, were you actually taking it seriously？
We're here, but... I wonder if they'll let us in.
We can't just walk in... let's find a security guard and ask.
Doesn't look like anyone's around... let's give up for today.
Okay... then it can't be helped.
Well, the ghost didn't necessarily pick it up. Let's ask at the information desk if it's been turned in.
A lace handkerchief... I'm afraid nothing's been turned in. I'm sorry.
No luck... let's give up for today.
